name: Phoenix-Feather Cap
author: voodoo573
description: Legendary wondrous item (requires attunement) from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. While attuned to this stylish cap, you can cast fly on yourself at will without the need for components. In addition, the cap has 2 charges. You can use an action to expend a charge to use Wild Shape as if you were a druid of 10th level. While using Wild Shape, you always retain one distinctive visual characteristic no matter what beast you are transformed into. The cap regains all of its expended charges whenever you finish a short or long rest .
summary: Legendary cap: cast fly at will and Wild Shape like a 10th-level druid.
